name: Muster
description: Scan your repositories for every surface coding agents need, and fix them.

skills.name: audit-a-repo
skills.description: When asked what a repository is missing for agents, or where a set of repositories stands.

skills.name: scrub-before-public

skills.name: fix-with-the-kit
